analysis.session_summary: Commodity-linked currencies led, with NZD +0.319%, AUD +0.197%, and CAD +0.110% closing firm, while CHF -0.348% and EUR -0.213% lagged. French services PMI missed and dragged EUR lower, but German PMI produced an inverted bounce, suggesting short positioning. US data were muted; USD recovered early losses to close slightly higher. The tape was choppy with most legs lacking a clear catalyst.

themes.evidence: NZD closed at its best (0.319%), AUD closed at its best (0.197%), CAD held its range (0.110%).
EUR -0.213%, GBP -0.171%, CHF -0.348%; French services PMI fell into contraction at 48.4 vs 50.7.
German Flash Services PMI missed (51.7 vs 52.5) but EUR strengthened 0.048%.

currency_drivers.USD: US data muted; early selling to -0.10% was rejected.
currency_drivers.EUR: French PMI miss dragged EUR lower, but German PMI inverted bounce limited damage.
currency_drivers.JPY: No own releases; early attempt higher was rejected and gave back 76%.
currency_drivers.GBP: Retail sales and services PMI both muted, leaving GBP soft with no clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own releases; commodity bid kept it firm and it closed at its best.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own releases; quiet range trade with mild strength.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own releases; early strength attempt failed, leaving CHF the weakest major.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; strongest major, closing at its best.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped through multiple uncaused legs; only the French services PMI miss provided a measurable push lower, net down 30.7 pips.

polarity_reads.read: EUR strengthened 0.048% despite a miss, implying short EUR positioning was squeezed and downside exhausted near-term.
EUR fell 0.093% on a contractionary miss, consistent with normal data-driven selling.

scenarios.name: Commodity FX continuation
scenarios.thesis: Broad risk appetite and commodity strength extend, keeping NZD/AUD/CAD bid while EUR and CHF remain pressured.
triggers: NZD/USD holds above 0.5699 close and extends
scenarios.invalidation: EUR/USD breaks back above 1.1193 and German PMI trend reverses.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD closed at its best and led commodity FX, supporting continuation.
NZD was strongest major, closing at its best.
CHF weakness and USD recovery favor upside.

scenarios.name: European bounce / mean reversion
scenarios.thesis: Stretched EUR and CHF weakness fade as short positioning unwinds; commodity gains take a breather.
scenarios.invalidation: NZD/USD makes fresh highs above 0.5699 and EUR/USD remains below 1.1193.

pair_paths.rationale: Daily drop of 30.7 pips reverses as short EUR positioning unwinds.
CHF short covering after 0.409% USD/CHF rise.
Commodity longs take profit after closed at best.

scenarios.name: Choppy range
scenarios.thesis: No calendar drivers leaves flows to dominate, with pairs holding recent ranges.
scenarios.invalidation: Break of EUR/USD daily range and a fresh headline catalyst.

pair_paths.rationale: Lack of catalyst keeps EUR/USD within its 46.5-pip daily range.
USD/JPY already traded a 107.9-pip range and closed mid-range, supporting mean reversion.

risks.risk: Inverted German data reaction signals crowded short EUR
risks.why_it_matters: A negative number failed to push EUR down, so further misses may trigger sharp EUR squeezes.
risks.watch: If German or euro-area data miss and EUR strengthens again.

risks.risk: CHF weakness is extreme and may bounce violently
risks.why_it_matters: CHF fell 0.348% and its early strength attempt was rejected; shorts are crowded.
risks.watch: USD/CHF reversal near 0.8251 close or safe-haven flows.

risks.risk: Commodity FX rally is vulnerable to risk-off
risks.why_it_matters: NZD/AUD/CAD led despite VIX rising 4.056%, so a sentiment turn could unwind quickly.
risks.watch: VIX 19.859 and any headline-driven risk reversal.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: No high-impact events are scheduled in the coming window; headline flow and technical levels will likely dominate.
